tips.text: Aim Death Sentence at enemies who walk up to last-hit; it stops at the first unit it hits, so keep minions out of the line.
After Death Sentence lands, recast it to dash to the enemy only when your team can follow up. Otherwise stay back and let the pull do the work.
Throw Dark Passage to an ally who is under pressure or going in. They click the lantern to dash to you, and you both get a shield.
Tell your teammates how you plan to use the lantern, so they know when to click it.
Pair Flay with Death Sentence in either order for a combo; Flay also leaves the enemy slowed afterward.
Hold off on attacking for a moment before you trade. Flay's bonus damage on your next attack grows the longer you wait.
At level 6, use The Box when several enemies are bunched up near you. Fight inside it, because the walls slow anyone who breaks them.
Stay close to fights and dying minions so Damnation collects souls. You don't need the kill yourself.
Aim Death Sentence when Alistar has used Headbutt. He is easy to hit while he is on cooldown.
Do not stand within reach of Alistar's Headbutt and Pulverize combo, especially near turrets. Keep your distance.
Use Flay to push Alistar away when he gets close, so he cannot hit you with Pulverize.
Back off when Alistar uses Unbreakable Will and wait for it to end before you fight him.
Throw Dark Passage to your ally so they can dash to you and get away from Alistar.
Hit Anivia with Death Sentence when she casts Crystallize or stands still; she has little to escape a pull.
Dodge Flash Frost by staying out of its line, since its stun comes at the end of its range or on recast.
Use Flay to push Anivia away or pull her into your carry when she is chilled and committed.
Be aggressive early; if Anivia returns from her egg, kill it fast or punish her low state.
Throw Dark Passage to give your ally a shield and a way out of Glacial Storm.
Aim Death Sentence at Bard when he walks up for chimes or to use his meeps; the stun and pull leave him with nowhere to go.
Use Flay to knock Bard back when he steps in close, and your next attack hits harder if you have waited a moment.
Walk over Bard's Caretaker's Shrine to destroy it before his ally can take the heal.
Stay out of a straight line with your own ally when Bard casts Cosmic Binding; it hits a second enemy, and both are stunned.
Use Dark Passage to put a shield on your ally when Bard threatens a trade.
Fight Bard when his Tempered Fate is on cooldown; with it ready he can freeze the whole fight, so keep The Box for after it.
Stay behind minions so Rocket Grab hits one of them first, because it only pulls the first enemy it meets.
Hit Death Sentence on Blitzcrank when he steps up; he is stunned and pulled, so you can fight him.
Use Flay to push Blitzcrank back when he runs at you, and he is slowed after.
Back off at level 6 when Blitzcrank is close, since Static Field silences and destroys your Dark Passage shield.
Punish Blitzcrank after he misses Rocket Grab; the cooldown is long, so you can move up safely.
Stay away from your partner when Brand is ready to cast Pyroclasm. Spreading out also blunts his passive.
Hit Brand with Death Sentence when he steps up to poke; he has no escape, so you can pull him into your team.
Dodge Sear and Pillar of Flame. Brand needs to land one spell before his combo starts.
Move as soon as Pillar of Flame appears under you; it erupts after a short delay.
Throw Dark Passage to give your partner a shield when Brand's spells are coming.
Use The Box when you catch Brand and his partner close together, since the walls slow whoever touches them.
Wait until Unbreakable is down before throwing Death Sentence, or throw it from an angle the shield does not cover.
Do not walk up beside Braum's ally to trade. Winter's Bite starts Concussive Blows, and each hit from his team brings the stun closer.
Use Flay to push Braum out of position when he closes in, and use Dark Passage to pull your carry back out of the fight.
Dodge Glacial Fissure by moving out of its line while he casts. Cast The Box if you get caught in the slow zone.
Hit Camille with Death Sentence when she dashes in with Hookshot. Her dash is easy to read.
Use Flay to push Camille away when she closes in. It also slows her.
Hit Camille when her shield is the wrong type. Adaptive Defenses blocks only physical or magic damage, not both.
Throw Dark Passage to your ally so they can pull away from Camille. The shield also helps them survive her burst.
Use The Box if Camille dives your carry. Break a wall yourself to let a trapped ally slip out.
Throw Death Sentence when Janna has used Zephyr or Howling Gale; she has little left to escape or peel with.
Do not stand close to Janna when she may have Howling Gale ready; it knocks you up and cancels your plans.
Hold The Box until Janna has used Monsoon, or use it first so she cannot push you out of the fight.
Harass Janna's ally; she is strongest when buffing them, so hurting them weakens her.
Use Flay to pull Janna toward you when she is out of position, then follow with Death Sentence.
Hit Death Sentence on Karma when she walks up to trade. She has no dash, so a hit usually means a kill or a big trade.
Avoid being hit by Inner Flame. It slows you, and every hit on a champion speeds up her Mantra.
Step out of a Mantra-boosted Inner Flame circle quickly. It leaves a field that slows you and then bursts for heavy damage.
Stay out of Focused Resolve range, or break the tether by moving away, so you avoid the root. Then you can start your own engage.
Throw Dark Passage to your ally after a hook lands, so they can dash to you and get a shield.
Hit Leona with Death Sentence when she walks up to engage, then pull her away from your carry.
Use Flay to knock Leona away when she dashes in with Zenith Blade; it breaks up her stun combo.
Move away when Leona raises Eclipse; her damage comes only when it ends, so do not stand beside her.
Step out of the center of Solar Flare quickly; only the center stuns, so you can often avoid it.
Put down The Box when Leona and her team commit onto you; it slows everyone who touches the walls.
Hook Lulu with Death Sentence when she walks up for minions; her escape tools are limited.
Stay out of Glitterlance range, and keep minions between you and Lulu so her bolts get blocked.
Expect Whimsy when you step in; wait until it is used before you commit to an all-in.
Flay Lulu away from her carry, then hook her; the slow makes the follow-up easier.
Break one wall of The Box on purpose to let a teammate escape Wild Growth.
Aim Death Sentence at Lux when she steps up to throw her spells; she has no dash, so a hit usually means a kill.
Stand behind minions so Light Binding hits them first; it stops after two enemies, so a minion in front protects you.
Step out of Lucent Singularity quickly; its slow gets worse when it bursts, and Lux often follows with Light Binding.
Move to the side when you see the red line from Final Spark; the beam is slow to start and you can dodge it.
Use Flay to pull Lux toward you when she's near and in range; combine it with Death Sentence for a lockdown.
Throw Dark Passage to your ally when Lux roots them, so they can escape toward you with a shield.
Don't spend spells on Maokai without a reason. Each spell that hits him speeds up his Sap Magic healing.
Don't throw Death Sentence when Maokai can dash with Twisted Advance. He can't be targeted while he dashes and the hook will miss.
Stay away from brush with a Maokai Sapling in it. It hits harder and slows you for longer than a normal one.
Use The Box on Maokai's team when he is rooted by his own Nature's Grasp setup, or break one wall on purpose to free an ally.
Put Dark Passage's shield on your carry when Maokai's Bramble Smash is ready; it softens the poke.
Wait until Mel has used Rebuttal before you throw Death Sentence; her nova destroys enemy projectiles, and your scythe is one.
Mel's Solar Snare roots from far away, so stay out of its line and keep minions between you and her.
Watch for Mel's spent abilities, then hook her. She has little to escape with once Solar Snare is down.
Back off when you are low on health. Mel's Overwhelm can execute you after a few hits, so give the stacks time to fall off.
Use The Box to trap Mel once she is low, since her Golden Eclipse needs a moment to cast.
Aim Death Sentence at Milio when he stands in front; he has no dash to escape it, and a hit lets you pull him into your team.
Flay can knock Milio back before his Ultra Mega Fire Kick lands. Use it when he steps up to cast.
Look for Milio when he is alone, away from his carry. Then Death Sentence and Flay are hard for him to answer.
Use The Box at level 6 when you catch both enemies close together. They get slowed hard and it deals big damage.
Stay out of the Ultra Mega Fire Kick line, and watch for the cast to begin, since Milio cannot cast anything else while it winds up.
Stay behind minions when Morgana is in range. Dark Binding stops at the first enemy it hits, so minions block it.
Throw Death Sentence right after Morgana uses Black Shield, or when it is on cooldown. While it is up, she can't be stunned or pulled.
Move out of Tormented Shadow instead of standing in it, especially when you are low on health. It hurts more the lower you are.
Use Dark Passage on your carry after Morgana wastes her Dark Binding. The shield helps them survive the poke.
Flay or Death Sentence a tethered ally out of Soul Shackles' range so they dodge the stun. Break the tether before the three seconds are up.
Hook Nami when she steps up for minions. If she is stunned or pulled, your lane partner can hit her freely.
Fight Nami right after she throws Aqua Prison. Its cooldown is long, so you can walk up without fear of the stun.
Use Flay to push Nami away from your ally when she tries to engage or peel. It also slows her.
Back off from an enemy carry who has Tidecaller's Blessing active. It only lasts a short time, so wait it out.
Sidestep Tidal Wave when you see it coming, since it travels slowly. Throw Dark Passage to a teammate caught in its path so they can escape.
Aim Death Sentence at Nautilus when he walks up; the stun gives your carry time to hit him.
Stay out of Dredge Line's long range line; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion between you and him.
Use Flay to push Nautilus away when he closes in; it also slows him.
Throw Dark Passage to a teammate caught by Nautilus so they can dash out and get a shield.
When Nautilus is shielded by Titan's Wrath, avoid fights close to him; his attacks hit everyone near the target.
Hold still after Riptide goes off next to you until the waves end; running early takes extra hits.
Aim Death Sentence at Neeko when she walks up to poke or to Tangle-Barbs; the stun leaves her open to Flay and a follow-up.
Stay out of a straight line with Neeko, and don't stand behind minions; Tangle-Barbs hits the first enemy and then comes back stronger.
Throw Dark Passage so your ally can escape after Neeko roots them, but only if they are not stuck by something that blocks it.
Be careful when Neeko looks like an ally and your team is near. Pop Blossom can come from her in secret.
Break a wall of The Box on purpose or throw Dark Passage when your ally is the target of Pop Blossom.
Throw Death Sentence when Pantheon is not bracing his shield; facing you, Aegis Assault makes him immune to damage from your direction.
Use Flay to push Pantheon away when he jumps in with Shield Vault; it also leaves him slowed.
Stay healthy near Pantheon; a thrown Comet Spear hits very hard on low health targets, so back off when you or your partner are low.
When Pantheon starts Grand Starfall, you get a warning; move your team out of the area or set up The Box where he will land.
Throw Dark Passage to your partner when Pantheon dives; the shield and quick pull-out can save them.
Do not leap with Death Sentence's recast while Steadfast Presence is up; Poppy stops the dash and slows you.
Stay away from walls when Poppy is near; Heroic Charge into terrain stuns you.
Step on Poppy's dropped buckler to destroy it and deny her the shield.
Use Flay to push Poppy away when she dashes in for Heroic Charge, or to pull her out of position.
Hook Poppy when she starts spinning her hammer for Keeper's Verdict; the stun cancels it.
Aim Death Sentence at Pyke when he is not holding Bone Skewer; the scythe stuns him and drags him to you.
Use Flay on Pyke when he dashes in; it knocks him back and leaves him slowed.
Throw Dark Passage to give your carry a shield and a way out when Pyke goes for them.
Stay away from low-health allies when Pyke is near; Death From Below can execute them. Watch for sharks under your feet.
Use The Box on Pyke if he commits onto you or an ally; he is slowed heavily inside it.
Aim Death Sentence at Rakan when he has no ally close by; his dashes need an ally, so he struggles to escape once hooked.
Death Sentence stops at the first unit it hits, so keep minions out of the line and wait for a clear shot at Rakan.
Rakan's Grand Entrance lands after a short delay, so Flay him away or step out of the circle before it knocks you up.
Drop The Box on Rakan and his partner when they dive in together; the walls slow them and block their escape.
Throw Dark Passage to your ally before Rakan's Gleaming Quill lands, so the shield soaks up some of the poke.
Throw Death Sentence when Rell is mounted and walking up. Cast it from far away, since her stun makes a close fight risky for you.
Rell's Shattering Strike destroys shields, so don't count on the Dark Passage shield when she is in range to stab you.
Use Flay to push Rell away when she leaps in or tries to charge you; it also leaves her slowed.
Watch for Rell's Ferromancy: Crash Down; it knocks up and stuns, so stay out of its range or back off after she lands.
Use The Box when enemies dive in, so they are stuck inside. Rell's Magnet Storm pulls enemies in, so keep your team out of it.
Aim Death Sentence at Senna when she steps up to hit minions or souls. Her long range makes her stay close to the wave.
Watch for her Last Embrace. It lands after a short delay, so keep moving and you may escape the root.
Use Flay to knock Senna back toward your team when she pokes. It also slows her.
Throw Dark Passage to your carry to shield them from Senna's poke, and pull them out if she hits them.
Use The Box to trap her at level 6 if she is close. Her Dawning Shadow beam can still hit from far away, so do not stand in a line with her.
Look for Death Sentence when Seraphine steps up to trade. Her spells are slow to cast, and a stun means she takes your whole combo.
Flay slows her. Follow with Death Sentence if you have a hit, or step out of her Beat Drop line.
Stay out of Beat Drop's line. If you are already slowed it roots you, so avoid being slowed in the first place.
Use The Box when you catch her and her team close together. Charm and slow punish anyone who walks into the walls.
Throw Dark Passage to shield yourself and your ally when you expect her to poke you.
Look for Shen's Shadow Dash before you commit; if it taunts you, you cannot get away, so keep distance from him in fights.
Aim Death Sentence at Shen when he has used Shadow Dash; his Energy is spent and he cannot easily get away.
Do not walk up to Shen for an attack while Spirit's Refuge is ready; it blocks basic attacks, so wait for it to end.
Flay can push Shen away from your ally when he lands on them; follow with Death Sentence to keep him from his Spirit Blade.
Watch for Stand United after level 6; Shen can arrive from anywhere to save an ally, so do not chase a low enemy too far.
Aim Death Sentence at Sona when she steps up to poke; she is fragile and a pull usually means a kill.
Stay behind minions so Sona's Hymn of Valor hits them rather than you, and don't walk forward for free pokes.
Use Flay when Sona is close to push her away from her carry, or to slow her when she runs.
Spread out from your carry so Crescendo can't stun you both; step out of its line when she aims it.
Hit Sona with Death Sentence, then use the recast to dash to her and follow up before her allies can help.
Hit Soraka with Death Sentence when she walks up to poke; she has no dash, so a hook usually gets you a kill chance.
Step out of Equinox's field right away; it silences you, then roots you when it ends.
Go all in when Equinox is on cooldown; Soraka has little to stop your engage then.
Dodge Starcall with sideways steps, or use Dark Passage's shield to soak it. Its slow makes your hook harder to line up.
Focus Soraka rather than your target's partner; she is easier to kill than the ally she heals.
Dodge Nevermove by staying away from your own minions and allies when Swain is in range; being rooted there sets up a pull toward him.
Hook Swain with Death Sentence when he casts Nevermove or Death's Hand. His spells leave him exposed, and the stun pulls him to you.
Keep moving when you see Vision of Empire's eye appear. It lands after a delay, so step out before it explodes.
Use The Box when Swain commits with Demonic Ascension, and break a wall yourself to let an ally escape.
Throw Death Sentence when Tahm Kench has just used Abyssal Dive. He cannot act for a moment after landing.
Do not trade into Tahm Kench for long; Thick Skin turns his damage taken into healing. Hit and back off.
Avoid taking Tongue Lash hits; at full stacks it stuns, and he can then swallow you with Devour.
Use Flay to push Tahm Kench away when he closes in, and The Box to trap him once he commits.
Hit Death Sentence on Taric when he walks up to attack; it stuns him and pulls him in, which cancels his Bravado trades.
Do not stand in a straight line with Taric when his Dazzle is ready; it winds up for a moment, so sidestep it.
Save Flay to push Taric away after he starts Dazzle, or to pull him toward your team.
When Taric starts Cosmic Radiance, kill a target or back off before it ends; do not waste The Box on invulnerable enemies.
Hit Vel'Koz with Death Sentence when he steps forward to poke. He has little mobility and cannot easily escape the pull.
Interrupt Life Form Disintegration Ray with Death Sentence or Flay. It stops his channel.
Use Dark Passage to give your carry a shield before Vel'Koz pokes, or to pull an ally out of his Void Rift.
Stay behind minions to block Plasma Fission. Its bolt hits the first enemy it meets.
Close the distance on Xerath. Once you're next to him, he has few ways to keep you off.
Throw Death Sentence when Xerath is charging Arcanopulse. He moves slowly then and is easy to hit.
After a Death Sentence hit, recast it to dash onto Xerath. Then Flay him away from your ally or back toward them.
Stay out of a straight line with Xerath. Shocking Orb stuns the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion between you and him.
Use Dark Passage to pull a stunned or slowed ally out of danger, or to give yourself a shield before you go in.
Use The Box on Xerath once you are on him. He can't move away, and the slow cuts off his dodging.
Yuumi can't be targeted while attached, so aim Death Sentence at her ally. Hook her when she is detached and wandering.
Hook Yuumi as she dashes with You and Me!. A stun while she dashes knocks her down and puts it on cooldown.
Use Flay on Yuumi when she is detached. Being knocked back leaves her stuck without an ally to attach to.
Step out of the way of Prowling Projectile; it is a slow missile that hits the first enemy it meets. Keep minions between you and it.
Use The Box on the enemy pair when they are close. Yuumi's partner takes the full slow while she can't be hit.
Aim Death Sentence at Zilean when he has no minion in front of him. He is fragile, and a pull into your team usually kills him.
Do not stand still with a Time Bomb on you. Walk away from your allies and minions so the blast hits only you.
Zilean can double-bomb you for a stun. Stay out of the range of his Time Bomb, or Flay him away after the first one lands.
If Zilean has Chronoshift ready, kill the other targets first. Hold your damage on the protected ally until the rune fades.
Zyra is fragile. Hit her with Death Sentence when she steps up to plant seeds or cast.
Stepping on a seed destroys it. Walk over seeds before Zyra can grow them into plants.
Use Flay to push enemies away from you when Zyra's plants and allies collapse on you. It also slows them.
Zyra's Grasping Roots has a long range and roots you. Keep Dark Passage ready so a teammate can dash out of trouble.
Fight away from Zyra's seeds. Moving the fight to a new area leaves her with fewer seeds.
